prompt:
Assess ISO readiness for: Industry: Shipbuilding, Company Size: 1100 employees, Pain Points: Confined space entry incidents, welding fume exposure, no integrated management system despite needing ISO 9001 + 14001 + 45001, project quality plans inconsistent across contracts

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- readinessScore (string): overall ISO readiness score
- gaps (string): identified gaps in current system
- recommendations (string): recommended actions to address gaps
- standards (string): applicable ISO standards

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"readinessScore": "Moderate", "gaps": "Lack of integrated management system, inconsistent project quality plans, confined space entry incidents, welding fume exposure risks, no formal environmental management system, fragmented safety procedures", "recommendations": "Develop integrated QMS/EMS/MSMS combining ISO 9001/14001/45001 requirements, implement standardized project quality planning templates, establish formal confined space entry permit system with atmospheric monitoring, install engineering controls and respiratory protection for welding fume exposure, conduct gap analysis against all three standards, train staff on integrated system requirements, establish continuous improvement processes with documented controls", "standards": "ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety)"}
